At the same time, moving at a human pace encourages greater awareness of local surroundings, turning ordinary journeys into chances to notice architecture, gardens, seasonal changes, and community details that often go unseen from behind a windshield, ultimately fostering a stronger sense of connection and enjoyment in one's own neighborhood.
